title: FrontLit content format
description: Markdown accepted for articles, product updates and documentation through the FrontLit API and MCP. Blocks are tags on their own lines with literal props.

markdown.syntax: CommonMark with GFM tables. Rich blocks are JSX-style tags on their own lines with literal props only; raw HTML, expressions and imports are refused.

blocks.name: image
blocks.summary: An image in standard Markdown image syntax.

blocks.name: callout
blocks.summary: A highlighted note holding any blocks.
blocks.example:
<Callout type="tip" title="Good to know">

Start with three tiers.

</Callout>

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Kind of note; the renderer picks its colour and icon. Absent means info.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Optional heading shown above the text.

blocks.name: tabs
blocks.summary: Content split into labelled tabs; each <Tab> holds any blocks.
blocks.example:
<Tabs items={["npm", "bun"]}>

<Tab value="npm">

npm install

</Tab>

<Tab value="bun">

bun add

</Tab>

</Tabs>

blocks.name: steps
blocks.summary: A numbered sequence; each <Step> holds any blocks, usually a heading first.

blocks.name: cards
blocks.summary: A grid of link cards; each <Card> has a title and optional href, icon and text.
blocks.example:
<Cards>

<Card title="Quick start" href="/docs/quick-start" icon={<Rocket />}>

Upload your first file.

</Card>

</Cards>

children.name: card
children.summary: One link card of a <Cards> grid.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: A lucide icon name, written as icon={<Rocket />}.

blocks.name: accordions
blocks.summary: Collapsible sections; each <Accordion> has a title and holds any blocks.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Whether one or several items can be open at once.

children.name: accordion
children.summary: One collapsible item of an <Accordions> block.

blocks.name: codeGroup
blocks.summary: Code fences shown as tabs; each fence's title="…" is its tab label.

blocks.name: typeTable
blocks.summary: A table of props or options with their types and defaults.
blocks.example:
<TypeTable
  type={{
    apiKey: { type: "string", default: "KEY", description: "Your key." },
  }}
/>

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Rows of name, type, default, description and required.

blocks.name: button
blocks.summary: A link styled as a button, for a call to action.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Where the button goes: https, http, mailto or a site path.

blocks.name: webPreview
blocks.summary: A link card previewing a web page, with an optional image.
blocks.example: <WebPreview url="https://example.com/guide" title="The guide" description="Everything in one place." />

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: The page to link to (http or https).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Card title. Absent shows the link's host name.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: One or two sentences about the page.

blocks.name: h5p
blocks.summary: An interactive H5P activity (quiz, flashcards, timeline…) by its embed URL.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: The activity's embed URL (https, on h5p.org or *.h5p.com).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Accessible title of the activity frame.
